scopeStatement: Freezes the target-specific C0 object layouts, unique-join predicates, double-collection rules, inherited Authority tick boundary, OriginalOnline isolation and fail-closed conditions. This artifact is not runtime C0 evidence and does not authorize hooks, IPC, remote calls, writes or apply.

reusedConcepts: OriginalOnline backend and roster read-only validation

reverseTools.reason: No active target/debug session existed; no attach, initialization, breakpoint, pause, step, remote call, patch or process write was attempted.

activeDeviceVector.validation: begin <= end <= capacityEnd; every boundary and object pointer is 4-byte aligned; active byte span is divisible by 8

inputManager.evidenceSource: Existing RPM implementation plus T0-04 target-specific static/runtime contracts

mainPlayerVector.validation: begin <= end <= capacityEnd; boundaries and non-null entries are 4-byte aligned; active byte span is divisible by 4

luaGetPlayer.validIndexRule: returns the main Player vector entry at the requested ordinal

player.evidenceSource: 05-01 Player/vector/assignment proof plus read-only IDA RTTI and InitSeed getter inspection in CS-T0-05-02

hud.positiveC0Rule: For each accepted base Player ordinal, the corresponding primary HUD record must contain the identical Player pointer without requiring twin, possessor or special normalization.
hud.specialNormalizationRule: Read Player+0x1E68 only to classify a non-base relation. Any positive join that requires this normalization is blocked for the fixed C0 base scenarios.
hud.evidenceSource: coop-static-evidence-v1, coop-static-graph-v1 and read-only IDA data-flow review

originalOnline.c0PositiveControlRule: Require aligned nonzero game root, manager and Steam backend; active run; 2-4 aligned non-null NetInputDevice entries; 2-4 nonzero distinct sorted peer identities; stable manager/backend/roster; and nonregressing onlineFrame.
originalOnline.localModeNegativeRule: Local C0 may pass only when OriginalOnline manager/backend/roster/onlineFrame satisfy the frozen offline negative screen; OriginalOnline objects must never explain the second local Player.
originalOnline.persistence: Persist roster count, distinctness and stability only; raw manager, backend, NetInputDevice, identity-object pointers and peer identity values are forbidden.
originalOnline.evidenceSource: Existing RPM OriginalOnline screen plus coop-static-evidence-v1 online guard

localSingleUniqueJoin.assignmentRule: Player[0]+0x1618 must equal the deviceKey of exactly one accepted active InputDevice.
localSingleUniqueJoin.hudRule: HUD primary record 0 points directly to Player[0].
localSingleUniqueJoin.luaRule: Isaac.GetPlayer(0) is recorded only as STATIC_VECTOR_EQUIVALENT to Player[0].
localSingleUniqueJoin.initSeedRule: Readable and stable across the accepted double collection; raw value is not persisted and does not participate in the join.

localDualUniqueJoin.playerIdentityRule: Both vector entries are non-null, aligned, distinct Entity_Player objects and Player+0x161C equals the vector ordinal.
localDualUniqueJoin.assignmentRule: For each ordinal, Player+0x1618 matches exactly one accepted active InputDevice deviceKey; no accepted device matches both Players and no Player has zero or multiple matches.
localDualUniqueJoin.extraDeviceRule: Additional active devices may be retained only as unassigned diagnostics and cannot satisfy or weaken either unique match.
localDualUniqueJoin.hudRule: HUD primary records 0 and 1 point directly to Player[0] and Player[1] respectively.
localDualUniqueJoin.luaRule: Isaac.GetPlayer(i) is recorded only as STATIC_VECTOR_EQUIVALENT to Player[i] for i in {0,1}; no Lua remote call is made.
localDualUniqueJoin.initSeedRule: Each seed is readable and stable across the accepted double collection; persist only SAME_OR_DISTINCT and stability summaries, never raw values or identity claims.

originalOnlineIsolation.rule: OriginalOnline manager/backend/roster/frame observations form an isolated read-only control graph and cannot be joined to local Player assignment, HUD or Lua publication as positive local evidence.

monotonicExceptions: OriginalOnline onlineFrame may increase but must not regress.
GameRoot+0x264F8 diagnostic frame proxy may increase but must not regress while process, run and mode remain stable; it is excluded from equality and Authority claims.
doubleCollectPolicy.windowRule: A mode source is accepted only after its required coherent samples preserve one topology for the complete observation window hash-bound by that source manifest. A later coherent topology mismatch is STRUCTURAL_DRIFT, not a disposable unstable read.

tickContract.commitRule: pre candidate is lastCompleted+1 and commits exactly once only after the supported steady-standard Room::Update returns normally; exception, overflow or lifecycle change does not commit
tickContract.c0ClaimBoundary: The inherited post-commit contract may satisfy topology planning, but this C0 layout artifact does not claim a new runtime observation or a local-coop post-commit count.

stopConditions.condition: Any predecessor, target, equivalence, static evidence, catalog, ledger or inherited Authority hash differs.
Any C0 result claims direct post-commit observation, equates GameRoot+0x264F8 with authorityTick, or derives normal-return commit from the pre-attempt proxy.
The decision consumer does not explicitly accept PASS_INHERITED_CONTRACT for this C0-only work package.
The separate C0 process-read authorization is absent or the predecessor still reports processRead=false for this run.
A debugger is attached, x32dbg/x64dbg is open for the target, or any frozen blocker process/forbidden module is present.
The process handle requests any bit outside 0x00101410.
Any Hook, patch, Native/helper load, IPC/mapping, scheduler, remote call, write or input apply/injection appears.
Any of the 53 frozen target slots differs before collection or after collection.
PID/creation, module base/size, loaded-module set or gameRoot changes within the source.
The fixed retry/window budget yields no coherent graph, or a later coherent sample has a different topology.
The scenario has the wrong Player count, or any required Player is null, misaligned, duplicated, has the wrong vtable, or has Player+0x161C unequal to its vector ordinal.
A required Player has zero or multiple accepted-device matches, one device matches both Players, or the local-dual selected kinds are not exactly Keyboard plus Gamepad.

Primary HUD pointer and vector ordinal disagree, a base-scenario join requires twin/possessor/special normalization, or Lua evidence is presented as runtime observed rather than STATIC_VECTOR_EQUIVALENT.
A pointer, deviceKey, platform id, InitSeed or OriginalOnline peer identity is persisted as a player, network, command or cross-run identity.
OriginalOnline manager/backend/NetInput/roster/channel state explains a local second Player or participates in a positive local assignment route.
The OriginalOnline control contains any T0-05 Hook, IPC/mapping, scheduler, apply or loaded T0-05 module.

unknowns.boundary: Accepted only as PASS_INHERITED_CONTRACT from the bound T0-04 final decision; a fresh local-coop post-commit count requires a later authorized passive observer.
C0 uses the statically proven main-vector-equivalent lookup and performs no remote call or Lua IPC.
No vtable, lifecycle, allocation, controller handle or observer slot is inferred by this layout artifact.
The +0x1E68 relation and HUD twin records are readable only to detect exclusion; they cannot rescue a failed base unique join.
The old controller-assignment candidate remains outside C0 positive routes.
This layout artifact fixes double-collection and retry semantics but does not invent a duration or interval; the create-new C0 source manifest must freeze both before runtime collection.
